description: This file defines an abstract class `GenericAbstractDispatcher` which implements the `LocalDispatcher` interface. It provides core scheduling and transaction management functionalities for dispatching services within the Apache OFBiz framework, including methods for scheduling recurring and one-time services, managing rollback and commit services, and integrating with job and messaging components.

classes.name: GenericAbstractDispatcher
classes.description: An abstract base class for service dispatchers managing scheduling, transaction control, and integration with OFBiz's job and messaging systems.

methods.name: initDispatchContext
methods.description: Initializes the dispatch context and registers the dispatcher.

methods.name: setName
methods.description: Sets the name of the dispatcher.

methods.name: schedule
methods.description: Schedules a service with detailed parameters, managing transaction suspension and resumption.

methods.name: addRollbackService
methods.description: Registers a rollback service to be executed if the main service fails.

methods.name: addCommitService
methods.description: Registers a commit service to be executed after the main service succeeds.

methods.name: getJobManager
methods.description: Retrieves the JobManager instance associated with the dispatcher.

methods.name: getDelegator
methods.description: Retrieves the Delegator instance managing entity operations.

methods.name: getSecurity
methods.description: Retrieves the Security instance for security context.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the name of the dispatcher.

methods.name: deregister
methods.description: Deregisters this dispatcher from the service container and removes cache entries.

methods.name: registerCallback
methods.description: Registers a callback for a specific service.
